body.label: Effect
body.html: Until your next turn, reduce forced movement against you by 2 units and gain +1 Defense against Shoves or Grapples. After this resolves, you may become Unstable; if you do, increase both benefits by 1.

surges.html: Remove Chilled, Shocked, or Concussed from yourself.

rider.title: BULWARK ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Rampart Form. While maintained: Reduce forced movement against you by 1 unit and adjacent allies by 1 unit.
